name: Habitat Stewardship Program for Aquatic Species at Risk
summary: Annual call funding community-level stewardship projects in Canada that mitigate threats to aquatic species at risk and improve their habitat, for one to three years.

amount.note: Projects may be under $25,000 in the last year of a multi-year project.

calls.label: Call for proposals, projects starting April 2027

status.quote: Funding is now available for one- to three-year projects, which can: begin April 1, 2027

deadline.quote: by December 18, 2026 at 23:59 (Pacific time). Proposals received after this time will not be considered.

pool.quote: A budget of approximately $4 million is available each fiscal year.

applicant_types.quote: Individuals research, academic and educational institutions Canadian individuals for-profit organizations, such as small businesses with less than 500 employees, companies, corporations, and industry associations local organizations such as community associations and groups

geography.quote: provides funding for projects submitted by Canadians that contribute directly to the recovery of species at risk

access.quote: project leads must complete a project proposal form and email it to the regional coordinator in the region in which the proposed project will be implemented

window.quote: A Call for Proposals for the subsequent fiscal year is held annually.

amount.quote: The fund is intended to support small projects, ranging from $25,000 to $125,000 per year.

co_finance_required.quote: for non-Indigenous project leads, a minimum of 1:1 matching contributions from non-federal sources is required
